D/ IVLIA AVGVSTA ; R/ PIETAS AVGG

Silver. Coin. Denarius of Julia Domna (193-217), RIC volume 4 part 1 no. 572, Rome mint issue of 196-211, Reece period 10. Obverse description: Bust coiffed and draped right. Obverse inscription: IVLIA AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Pietas standing left sprinkling flame on altar. Reverse inscription: PIETAS AVGG. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.47gms, die axis: 6
